items.title: Arada Capital与Alya签署约60亿迪拉姆住宅开发合作备忘录
items.title_en: Arada Capital and Alya sign residential development partnership MoU targeting AED6bn pipeline
items.summary: Arada Capital与Alya于11月12日签署住宅开发及共同投资合作备忘录，初步研究迪拜Downtown Dubai及阿布扎比Yas Island两个开发项目，合计预计总开发价值约60亿迪拉姆。该金额是GDV，不是已投入资本或建筑授标，项目仍待尽调、商业协议和审批。
items.summary_en: On 12 November, Arada Capital and Alya signed an MoU for residential development and co-investment, initially evaluating projects in Downtown Dubai and Yas Island, Abu Dhabi, with anticipated combined gross development value of about AED6 billion. GDV is not capital expenditure or an EPC award; projects remain subject to due diligence, commercial agreement and approvals.
items.why_it_matters: 开发管线有潜在建设及精装需求，但尚未落实具体施工合同。
items.why_it_matters_en: The proposed development pipeline may yield construction and fit-out opportunities but no specific construction award has been confirmed.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注开发商对接、建筑劳务、机电、装修及家具供应。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Explore developer relationships, construction workforce, MEP, fit-out and furniture supply.

items.title: 阿曼Hydrom签署杜库姆两项绿氢项目开发协议
items.title_en: Oman's Hydrom awards two integrated green hydrogen projects in Duqm
items.summary: 阿曼Hydrom于11月12日在COP31宣布第三轮拍卖中两项杜库姆综合绿氢项目开发协议，计划至2032年合计年产约12.1万吨绿氢，并配套绿色硝酸铵及绿氨生产。两个联合体分别涉及Petrogas E&P与Bio3 Energy，以及PLN Indonesia Renewables、Alawi Enterprises和HBA Offshore。开发协议并非已授EPC合同。
items.summary_en: At COP31 on 12 November, Oman's Hydrom announced two integrated green hydrogen project development agreements in Duqm under its third auction round, targeting approximately 121,000 tonnes per year of green hydrogen by 2032 and associated green ammonium nitrate and ammonia production. The consortia include Petrogas E&P with Bio3 Energy, and PLN Indonesia Renewables with Alawi Enterprises and HBA Offshore. These are development awards, not EPC construction contracts.
items.why_it_matters: 协议明确未来新能源项目开发方向，工程和设备采购须继续跟进。
items.why_it_matters_en: The development agreements identify a prospective clean-energy project pipeline; engineering and equipment packages require further tracking.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注光伏、电解槽、绿氨设备、工业厂房、管道及工程供应链。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track PV, electrolysers, green ammonia systems, industrial facilities, piping and engineering supply chains.

items.title: 阿曼启动第四轮绿氢与AI数据中心供电投资征集
items.title_en: Oman launches fourth green hydrogen auction linked to AI data centre power demand
items.sector: 绿能开发与数据中心供电
items.summary: 阿曼Hydrom于11月12日启动第四轮绿色能源项目投资征集，着重可再生能源、绿氢生产与人工智能数据中心的供电协同。投资者注册开放，初步截止窗口为2027年2月，最终资格、范围及准确时点以Hydrom正式征集文件为准。此为独立于当天两项第三轮开发协议的投资征集。
items.summary_en: On 12 November, Hydrom opened its fourth green energy auction round, linking renewable electricity and hydrogen opportunities to power demand from AI data centres. Investor registration is open with a preliminary February 2027 horizon; exact deadlines, eligibility and project specifications must be confirmed in Hydrom's official materials. This is separate from the two third-round Duqm development awards.
items.why_it_matters: 投资征集阶段可提前寻找具备资质的开发商及中资能源企业。
items.why_it_matters_en: The investment solicitation is an early entry point for qualified developers and Chinese renewable-energy partners.
items.gci_opportunity: 对接新能源投资者、数据中心供电企业及绿氢技术供应商。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Engage renewable investors, data-centre power developers and hydrogen technology suppliers.

items.title: Oman Air与GMF AeroAsia启动航空维修合资企业Oman GMF Technic
items.title_en: Oman Air and GMF AeroAsia launch Oman GMF Technic aviation MRO venture
items.category: 合资企业启动／设施启用
items.summary: Oman Air与印度尼西亚GMF AeroAsia于11月11日宣布启动Oman GMF Technic，在马斯喀特国际机场现有航空维修设施开展飞机基地维修、航线维护及相关服务。该消息是业务及设施启动，而非新建机场工程授标。
items.summary_en: On 11 November, Oman Air and Indonesia's GMF AeroAsia launched Oman GMF Technic, an aviation maintenance, repair and overhaul venture using existing facilities at Muscat International Airport for base and line maintenance services. This is an operational launch, not an awarded airport construction project.
items.why_it_matters: 维修业务可形成长期设备、零配件及专业技术服务需求。
items.why_it_matters_en: The venture may generate ongoing demand for MRO equipment, spare parts and specialist technical services.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注航空维修工具、零配件、技术服务及供应商合作。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track aviation maintenance tools, spare parts, technical services and vendor partnerships.

items.title: 阿联酋外贸部与DHL Express合作支持逾万家企业出口
items.title_en: UAE Ministry of Foreign Trade and DHL Express launch export readiness partnership
items.summary: 阿联酋外贸部与DHL Express于11月12日签署合作备忘录，推动Export Readiness计划，目标帮助超过一万家在阿企业提升出口能力、了解CEPA协定市场及国际物流和贸易实务。此为企业扶持合作，不是物流园施工合同。
items.summary_en: On 12 November, the UAE Ministry of Foreign Trade and DHL Express entered a partnership supporting the Export Readiness initiative, targeting more than 10,000 UAE-based businesses with export preparedness, CEPA market access and international logistics capabilities. This is a business development programme, not a logistics construction award.
items.why_it_matters: 有助于寻找跨境贸易与品牌出海客户，直接商务价值高于工程价值。
items.why_it_matters_en: The programme could provide export and market-entry customer leads, with more direct commercial-services relevance than construction relevance.
items.gci_opportunity: 开发进出口企业、贸易文件、市场进入与供应链服务客户。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Develop relationships with exporters and importers for documentation, market entry and supply-chain support.

items.title: RAKEZ与阿联酋外贸部推进CEPA企业合作及供应链对接
items.title_en: RAKEZ and UAE Ministry of Foreign Trade advance CEPA business and supply-chain engagement
items.summary: RAKEZ与阿联酋外贸部于11月12日面向制造、贸易及物流企业开展CEPA贸易机遇交流，涉及原产地规则、优惠关税、供应链多元化及国际市场准入。该活动是企业对接与政策说明，并非已签工程合同。
items.summary_en: On 12 November, Ras Al Khaimah Economic Zone and the UAE Ministry of Foreign Trade engaged manufacturing, trading and logistics businesses around CEPA-related market opportunities, rules of origin, preferential tariffs and supply-chain diversification. This is business outreach and trade-policy information, not an EPC contract award.
items.why_it_matters: 有助于GCI在北部酋长国开发工业和国际贸易客户。
items.why_it_matters_en: The outreach can help GCI connect with manufacturing and cross-border trade clients in the northern emirates.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注RAKEZ制造商、进出口贸易商和中国供应链配套业务。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Engage RAKEZ manufacturers, importers, exporters and Chinese supply-chain partners.

items.title: 莫桑比克—坦桑尼亚400kV电力互联项目可行性研究合同授标
items.title_en: Feasibility consultancy awarded for 400kV Mozambique–Tanzania power interconnector
items.sector: 跨境输电与电力基础设施
items.summary: 非洲开发银行于11月11日公布400kV莫桑比克—坦桑尼亚（MOTA）跨境电力互联项目的可行性研究咨询合同授标结果，工作范围包括电力市场分析、线路与电网研究、经济财务可行性、初步设计和招标文件。现阶段不是公开EPC施工招标。
items.summary_en: On 11 November, the African Development Bank published a consultancy contract award for the 400kV Mozambique–Tanzania (MOTA) power interconnection feasibility study. Scope includes power market and grid studies, route assessment, technical and financial feasibility, preliminary design and procurement preparation. It is not currently an open EPC construction tender.
items.why_it_matters: 处于早期研究阶段，未来可能形成输电线路和变电站工程机会。
items.why_it_matters_en: The early feasibility stage could develop into future transmission line and substation procurement.
items.gci_opportunity: 长期跟踪电力EPC、铁塔、变电站、电缆及中资工程合作。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Monitor long-term power EPC, towers, substations, cables and Chinese contractor partnerships.
